summary: The editions largely agree on the core event—a massacre of Polish civilians by Soviet partisans in Naliboki—but diverge on details. RU gives a precise death toll of 129 including demographic breakdown, while EN gives an approximate range of 127-128 and PL omits a number entirely. PL also omits the specific date. Descriptions of the settlement differ (town vs. village), and RU emphasizes the forest location without noting German occupation, which EN and IT explicitly state.
